study.title: GAAIS – General Attitudes towards Artificial Intelligence Scale
study.citation: Schepman, A., & Rodway, P. (2023). The General Attitudes towards Artificial Intelligence Scale (GAAIS): Confirmatory validation and associations with personality, corporate distrust, and general trust. International Journal of Human–Computer Interaction, 39(13), 2724–2741. https://doi.org/10.1080/10447318.2022.2085400 — initial validation: Schepman, A., & Rodway, P. (2020). Initial validation of the general attitudes towards artificial intelligence scale. Computers in Human Behavior Reports, 1, 100014. https://doi.org/10.1016/j.chbr.2020.100014
study.abstract: 20-item scale of general attitudes towards artificial intelligence with two subscales: positive attitudes (12 items: societal and personal utility, positive emotions) and negative attitudes (8 items: concerns, negative emotions). Validated with UK adults; five-point agreement scale. The negative items are reverse-scored; no overall score is formed.

survey.name: gaais
survey.label: We are interested in your attitudes towards Artificial Intelligence. By Artificial Intelligence we mean devices that can perform tasks that would usually require human intelligence. Please note that these can be computers, robots or other hardware devices, possibly augmented with sensors or cameras, etc. Please complete the following scale, indicating your response to each item.

survey.name: gaais_pos1
survey.label: For routine transactions, I would rather interact with an artificially intelligent system than with a human.

survey.name: gaais_pos2
survey.label: Artificial Intelligence can provide new economic opportunities for this country.

survey.name: gaais_neg3
survey.label: Organisations use Artificial Intelligence unethically.

survey.name: gaais_pos4
survey.label: Artificially intelligent systems can help people feel happier.

survey.name: gaais_pos5
survey.label: I am impressed by what Artificial Intelligence can do.

survey.name: gaais_neg6
survey.label: I think artificially intelligent systems make many errors.

survey.name: gaais_pos7
survey.label: I am interested in using artificially intelligent systems in my daily life.

survey.name: gaais_neg8
survey.label: I find Artificial Intelligence sinister.

survey.name: gaais_neg9
survey.label: Artificial Intelligence might take control of people.

survey.name: gaais_neg10
survey.label: I think Artificial Intelligence is dangerous.

survey.name: gaais_pos11
survey.label: Artificial Intelligence can have positive impacts on people’s wellbeing.

survey.name: gaais_pos12
survey.label: Artificial Intelligence is exciting.

survey.name: gaais_pos13
survey.label: An artificially intelligent agent would be better than an employee in many routine jobs.

survey.name: gaais_pos14
survey.label: There are many beneficial applications of Artificial Intelligence.

survey.name: gaais_neg15
survey.label: I shiver with discomfort when I think about future uses of Artificial Intelligence.

survey.name: gaais_pos16
survey.label: Artificially intelligent systems can perform better than humans.

survey.name: gaais_pos17
survey.label: Much of society will benefit from a future full of Artificial Intelligence.

survey.name: gaais_pos18
survey.label: I would like to use Artificial Intelligence in my own job.

survey.name: gaais_neg19
survey.label: People like me will suffer if Artificial Intelligence is used more and more.

survey.name: gaais_neg20
survey.label: Artificial Intelligence is used to spy on people.
